user.title: Heat pump
user.description: Which entities carry the heat pump values? The suggestions match packages/dimplex_wpm.yaml. Empty fields are left out of the panel.

data_description.ent_outdoor: Also used for the condition "do not lower when it is too cold".
data_description.ent_dhw: Also used for the condition "do not lower when the hot water is too cold".
data_description.ent_power_el: Lets the control take the heat pump out of the surplus and learn how much it draws while running.
data_description.ent_compressor: For the notifications “short cycling” and “raising without effect”. Without this sensor, an electrical power of 300 W or more counts as running.
data_description.ent_fault: Fault code (0 = no fault), a text such as “Kein Fehler” or a binary_sensor. A fault present for 1 min is notified.

power.title: Electricity
power.description: For the electricity section and the overview. Display and analysis only, nothing is controlled: battery and wallbox keep managing themselves. Power sensors in W or kW are needed. Daily energy is calculated from them, or from kWh counters if you add them.

data_description.ent_grid_import_energy: Meter readings in kWh as in the energy dashboard (state class total_increasing or total). When set, daily and hourly values come from them instead of power. This is more accurate because short switches between import and export do not cancel out. Without counters here the panel uses those from the inverter step.
data_description.ent_grid_power: One signed sensor: import and export.
data_description.ent_battery_soc: From state of charge and battery power Energy Hub learns the battery capacity. The control uses it to see whether the battery will be full today anyway.
data_description.ent_house_power: Leave empty to calculate consumption from PV, grid and battery.
data_description.consumers: Power sensors of single appliances, for example bathroom heater, washing machine, dryer, dishwasher. The heat pump comes from the step "Heat pump".

pv.title: Photovoltaics
pv.description: The control follows these values. Without a surplus sensor the heating stays in normal operation.

data.ent_forecast_today: PV forecast for the rest of today

data_description.ent_pv_surplus: Power in W or kW that is currently left over, for example the grid export. Preferably the raw value; Energy Hub averages by itself (step Rules).
data_description.ent_forecast_today: Energy in kWh or Wh, for example from Solcast or Forecast.Solar. Needed for lowering.
data_description.ent_forecast_tomorrow: Counts for lowering before midnight when the lowering window spans midnight (for example 21:00–10:00).

inverter.title: Inverter
inverter.description: For the PV area. Display and analysis only, nothing is controlled here. Everything is optional. The panel finds Tigo optimizers by itself when the tigo_rs485 integration is set up.

data_description.ent_inv_status: Text or code. Codes 0 to 7 of ZCS Azzurro and Sofar are translated, for example 2 = on grid.
data_description.ent_mppt1_power: Power at the DC input in W or kW. Leave empty to calculate it from voltage times current.
data_description.ent_pv_energy_today: Counters of the inverter in kWh. They are shown in the PV area, compared with the optimizers and exported.
data_description.tigo_string_mppt1: String name as in tigo_rs485, for example A. Leave empty: if there is only one string, it belongs to MPPT 1.

storage.title: Fireplace and storage tank
storage.description: For systems with a water-jacket fireplace and a storage tank the heating draws from. Everything is optional; without a tank leave this step empty.

data.storage_ready_delta_k: Tank counts as ready from return target temperature plus
data.storage_ready_c: Fallback threshold when no return target temperature is available
data.storage_blocks_boost: Do not raise while the tank is ready
data.lock_regen_value: Lock value while the tank supplies heat

data_description.ent_storage: With Dimplex the sensor R13 in the renewable storage tank.
data_description.storage_ready_delta_k: This is how the Dimplex controller decides as well. Enter the value set on the heat pump manager as excess temperature for the renewable storage tank (2 to 20 K).
data_description.storage_ready_c: Only applies while no return target temperature is configured under "Heat pump" or it is unavailable.
data_description.storage_blocks_boost: In smart grid state green a Dimplex does not discharge the tank. Without this rule the heat pump would run although heat from the fireplace is available.
data_description.ent_lock: Used to detect when and how often heat was drawn from the tank.
data_description.lock_regen_value: With Dimplex "Regenerativ" (text) or 14 (code). Separate several values with commas.
data_description.ent_fireplace: For example the exhaust temperature of a Spartherm S-Thermatik NEO.
data_description.fireplace_on_c: Above this temperature the fireplace counts as burning.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: The heating is raised when enough own power is left over for the heat pump, and raised strongly when even more is left while raising. It is lowered within the lowering window when the forecast promises enough sun later.

data.boost_on_learned: Adapt the threshold to the heat pump
data.boost_off_min: … once it has stayed below for
data.strong_on_w: Raise strongly when still left over while raising
data.dhw_reload: Top up hot water in the afternoon
data.dhw_reload_hyst_k: Hot water hysteresis while topping up
data.setback_min_outdoor_c: Do not lower below outdoor temperature
data.setback_min_dhw_c: Do not lower below hot water temperature

data_description.boost_on_w: Compared with what is left over for the heat pump: the surplus plus what it draws itself right now (step Heat pump, electrical power). Without that power the surplus alone counts.
data_description.boost_on_learned: Instead of the fixed threshold, what the heat pump draws while running applies once Energy Hub has learned it from 30 min of runtime. The value slowly follows the season.
data_description.boost_off_w: Negative means: raising continues as long as at most this much comes from battery or grid.
data_description.off_without_battery: Raising stops by the surplus plus the battery charging power. It keeps going while PV carries the heat pump and stops when the battery would have to help. Power from the battery does not count as left over for the heat pump. If the forecast fills the battery today anyway, its charging power counts when raising (needs the battery state of charge). Only with a battery power sensor (step Power). Switch off if the surplus sensor already leaves the battery out.
data_description.dhw_reload: Once a day, after noon: when for 10 min only between the heat pump's power and 1.5 times that is left over, the battery is full and the hot water is at least 4 K below its target, Energy Hub lowers the hot water hysteresis for a while. The heat pump then tops up with the last solar power instead of at night. Needs the hysteresis entity (step Actuator) and hot water temperature and target (step Heat pump).
data_description.dhw_reload_hyst_k: Afterwards the previous value is restored, also after a restart.
data_description.strong_on_w: Measured on the surplus while raised. If it stays above for as long as for raising, the second stage starts; when PV no longer carries it, back to the first. What the second stage does is set on the heat pump.
data_description.smoothing_min: Short clouds count less. 0 = no smoothing, for example if the sensor is already averaged. If the sensor drops out, its last value counts for 3 more minutes.
data_description.min_hold_min: Protects the compressor from frequent switching. Manual mode and missing readings apply immediately.
data_description.setback_min_forecast_kwh: Forecast for the rest of today; if the lowering window spans midnight, before midnight the forecast for tomorrow.
data_description.setback_min_outdoor_c: Clear the field to switch the condition off.
data_description.setback_min_dhw_c: Clear the field to switch the condition off.

actuator.title: Action on the heat pump
actuator.description: What is used to raise and lower? In trial mode the control only logs what it would do.

data_description.ent_smart_grid: Select entity that writes the smart grid state of the heat pump.
data_description.opt_normal: Must be spelled exactly as in the select entity.
data_description.opt_strong: If the select has no such option, Energy Hub sets the option for raising.
data_description.ent_dhw_hysteresis: Number entity for the hot water hysteresis, used to top up in the afternoon (step Rules). Written with Smart Grid too; not in trial mode.
data_description.ent_shift: Number entity for the parallel shift of the heating curve. The value before the action is remembered and restored afterwards.

export.title: Efficiency and export
export.description: Meters and auxiliary heaters for the efficiency analysis, plus further sensors to include in the history export. Everything is optional; whatever is missing stays empty in the export.

data.ent_energy_el: Electricity meter of the heat pump
data.export_extra: Further sensors for the history export

data_description.ent_energy_el: Meter reading in kWh, for example from a dedicated electricity meter. Without a meter the electricity is summed from the electrical power.
data_description.ent_energy_heat: Meter reading in kWh from the heat meter.
data_description.export_extra: For example status codes, setpoints, runtimes or pumps.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Energy Hub reports anomalies at the heat pump and errors of the control, optionally every action as well. Each anomaly is sent once and once more with “back to normal”, the same one at most every 6 hours. They are listed in the panel log even without a service. After saving, a test message is sent.

data_description.notify_service: A service from notify, for example notify.mobile_app_your_phone for the companion app. Empty = no notifications.
data_description.notify_level: “Everything” helps to check the control, especially in trial mode: every log entry is sent to the phone.

error.thresholds: The threshold to stop must be below the threshold to raise.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Energy Hub is already set up.

set_override.name: Start manual mode
set_override.description: Holds the heating in one state regardless of the rules.

mode.name: State
mode.description: Normal operation, raise, raise strongly or lower.

minutes.name: Duration
minutes.description: Leave empty to keep manual mode until it is ended.

clear_override.name: End manual mode
clear_override.description: Hands the heating back to the automatic control.
